description.en: A 1.5 V AAA-size cylindrical cell, 10.5 mm across and 44.5 mm long at most, to the IEC LR03 (ANSI 24A) designation. The pip end is positive and the flat end negative; it goes into a battery bay or holder between two contacts.
description.es: Una pila cilíndrica de tamaño AAA de 1.5 V, de 10.5 mm de diámetro y 44.5 mm de largo como máximo, según la designación IEC LR03 (ANSI 24A). El extremo con botón es el positivo y el plano el negativo; va en un compartimento o portapilas entre dos contactos.
description.fr: Une pile cylindrique au format AAA de 1,5 V, de 10,5 mm de diamètre et 44,5 mm de long au plus, selon la désignation CEI LR03 (ANSI 24A). L'extrémité à téton est positive et l'extrémité plate négative ; elle se loge dans un compartiment ou un support entre deux contacts.
description.pt: Uma pilha cilíndrica de tamanho AAA de 1,5 V, com 10,5 mm de diâmetro e 44,5 mm de comprimento no máximo, segundo a designação IEC LR03 (ANSI 24A). A extremidade com pino é o polo positivo e a plana o negativo; vai num compartimento ou suporte entre dois contatos.

sources.title: Energizer E92 AAA alkaline product datasheet (form E92NA0425)
sources.supports: designation ANSI-24A, IEC-LR03; nominal 1.5 V; typical weight 11.5 g; industry-standard dimensions: diameter 10.50 max / 9.80 min; height 44.50 max / 43.50 min; positive pip diameter 3.80 max, pip height 0.80 min; negative contact diameter 4.30 min (values as the page renders them; the file's hidden text layer also holds 9.50 and 43.30, which are not drawn)

sources.title: Duracell Coppertop MN2400 size AAA technical datasheet (MN24USCT0122)
sources.supports: dimensions shown are ANSI standards: diameter 10.5 / 9.5; height 44.5 / 43.5; pip 3.8 max, pip height 0.8 min; nominal 1.5 V; typical weight 13 g; ANSI 24AP

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the negative (flat) end, on the cell's axis. +z runs along the axis to the tip of the positive pip at z = 44.5, the cited maximum height. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the cell is round, so every interface has continuous symmetry.

diameter_min.note: Energizer 9.80 min as rendered; Duracell draws 9.5 (source 1): the makers disagree, so a bay should take the smaller

pip_diameter_max.note: the positive terminal's raised pip; Duracell the same (source 1)

pip_height_min.note: how far the pip stands proud; Duracell the same (source 1)

negative_contact_diameter_min.note: the flat negative contact; Duracell does not draw it

interfaces.note: Neutral: the flat negative end presses on a bay's contact (usually the spring). Its own size key, so a positive contact cannot mate it.
Neutral: the pip presses on the bay's positive contact. Framed at the cited maximum height; a cell measures 43.5–44.5.
Male: the cell goes into a bay or holder, negative end first against the bay's negative contact. Which terminal meets which contact is the end interfaces' job.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: IEC 60086-2, which fixes the LR03 size, is not freely published; the numbers cite two makers' drawings of the alkaline AAA (Energizer prints IEC-LR03 and ANSI-24A, Duracell says its dimensions are the ANSI standard's). They agree except for the minimum diameter (9.80 against 9.5). Energizer's PDF carries a hidden text layer with 9.50 and 43.30 that the page does not draw; the rendered 9.80 and 43.50 are cited. Other chemistries sold in the AAA size are not covered by these sources.

solids.note: the cell at its maximum diameter and height, pip included

envelope.note: A cylinder at the cited maximum diameter and height; the pip and the shoulder are not modelled separately.
